3.name: Primal Companion (Beast Master)
3.description: Bond with a Beast of the Land, Sea, or Sky that acts on your turn and strikes when you command it with a Bonus Action or Attack sacrifice.

7.name: Exceptional Training (Beast Master)
7.description: Your Primal Companion can Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help as a Bonus Action, and its strikes deal Force or normal damage.

11.name: Bestial Fury (Beast Master)
11.description: Your Primal Companion makes two Beast's Strike attacks when commanded and deals bonus Hunter's Mark force damage once per turn.

15.name: Share Spells (Beast Master)
15.description: Spells you cast targeting yourself also affect your Primal Companion if within 30 feet.

3.name: Dreadful Strikes & Otherworldly Glamour (Fey Wanderer)
3.description: Deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage once per turn per target on weapon hits, add your WIS modifier to Charisma checks, and prepare Fey Wanderer spells.

7.name: Beguiling Twist (Fey Wanderer)
7.description: Gain Advantage on saves vs Charmed/Frightened, and use your Reaction when a nearby creature saves against those conditions to bounce it to another creature.

11.name: Fey Reinforcements (Fey Wanderer)
11.description: Always have Summon Fey prepared, cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, and optionally cast it without Concentration lasting 1 minute.

15.name: Misty Wanderer (Fey Wanderer)
15.description: Always have Misty Step prepared, cast it WIS modifier times per Long Rest, and bring one willing ally within 5 feet with you.

dreadful_strikes.name: Dreadful Strikes
dreadful_strikes.hint: Once per turn per target on a weapon hit: deal extra Psychic damage.

3.name: Dread Ambusher & Umbral Sight (Gloom Stalker)
3.description: Add your WIS modifier to Initiative, gain Darkvision (and invisibility to Darkvision in darkness), keep Gloom Stalker spells prepared, and empower Dread Ambusher strikes.

7.name: Iron Mind (Gloom Stalker)
7.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or INT/CHA if already proficient).

11.name: Stalker's Flurry (Gloom Stalker)
11.description: Dreadful Strike scales to 2d8 Psychic damage and triggers Sudden Strike (additional attack) or Mass Fear around the target.

15.name: Shadowy Dodge (Gloom Stalker)
15.description: Use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an incoming attack roll against you and teleport 30 feet if the attack misses.

dread_ambusher.name: Dreadful Strike
dread_ambusher.hint: Once per turn on a weapon hit (WIS mod uses per Long Rest): deal extra Psychic damage (scales to 2d8 at L11).

3.name: Hunter's Lore & Hunter's Prey (Hunter)
3.description: Learn a Hunter's Mark target's immunities, resistances, and vulnerabilities, and choose Colossus Slayer or Horde Breaker.

7.name: Defensive Tactics (Hunter)
7.description: Choose Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you) or Multiattack Defense (when a creature hits you, it has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn); you can change your choice after a Short or Long Rest.

11.name: Superior Hunter's Prey (Hunter)
11.description: Once per turn when dealing Hunter's Prey damage to a marked target, deal equal damage to another creature within 30 feet of it.

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense (Hunter)
15.description: When you take damage, use your Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and to any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

colossus_slayer.name: Colossus Slayer
colossus_slayer.hint: Once per turn, against a creature already below its hit point maximum.

3.name: Detect Portal & Planar Warrior (Horizon Walker)
3.description: Sense nearby planar portals and use a Bonus Action to convert your next weapon hit's damage to Force plus +1d8 Force (+2d8 at Level 11).

7.name: Ethereal Step (Horizon Walker)
7.description: Bonus Action casts Etherealness until the end of your current turn (1/Short or Long Rest).

11.name: Distant Strike (Horizon Walker)
11.description: Teleport up to 10 feet before each weapon attack and gain a 3rd attack if you target two different creatures.

15.name: Spectral Defense (Horizon Walker)
15.description: Use your Reaction when damaged by an attack to grant yourself Resistance to all of that attack's damage.

planar_warrior.name: Planar Warrior
planar_warrior.hint: Bonus action: all attack damage becomes force damage, plus extra force damage.

distant_strike.name: Distant Strike
distant_strike.hint: Attack action: teleport up to 10ft before each attack. Attack 2 different foes to make a 3rd attack.

spectral_defense.name: Spectral Defense
spectral_defense.hint: Reaction: when you take damage from an attack, give yourself resistance to all of that attack's damage.
